title: Head of Customer Success - Loyalty and Partner Platforms (B2B)
description: We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, a nd AI-savvy Head of Customer Success to join as our first dedicated Customer Success hire owning the onboarding and lifecycle management of B2B customers within the qiibee ecosystem (partnered with Miles & More, Etihad Guest, and more). In this role, you'll combine customer empathy with AI-powered workflows to lead customers through every stage — from technical setup to live launch, campaign optimization, and ongoing success management. You'll be the key point of ownership for customer relationships, ensuring each customer maximizes the value of their loyalty partnership through proper visibility, communication, and engagement — supported by AI at every step. Tasks Own the end-to-end onboarding of new customers — from setup to go-live. Lead partners through the Launch Checklist, ensuring all milestones (integration, balance top-up, listing, communication review) are completed on time. Own the operational customer relationship for all active customers. Align with the sales team on customer success strategy and KPIs. Drive visibility and performance optimization for customers across all touchpoints within the partner’s cross-media mix. Ensure all communication and visuals meet brand and compliance guidelines. Own a best-in-class CRM in HubSpot , using AI to auto-log interactions, enrich contact data, flag stale records, and keep pipelines clean without manual busywork. Lead regular customer reviews, pulling and analyzing performance data to identify areas for improvement. Own issue resolution and customer feedback loops to continuously improve the customer experience. Accelerate issue r esolution with AI — using it to categorize incoming support tickets, draft initial responses, surface relevant knowledge-base articles, and close the feedback loop faster. Requirements Fluent in German and English 5+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or partner onboarding within the loyalty , SaaS, or payments industries. Proficiency in using AI tools, such as Claude , to build workflows and automations. A good understanding of digital integrations , including API connections, web links, voucher uploads, and campaign dashboards. Hands-on experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM systems. A structured, ownership-driven approach and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. An empathetic communicator with a consultative, solution-oriented mindset who can combine human judgment with AI-generated insights to deliver better outcomes. Comfortable working across teams and time zones and using AI to draft asynchronous updates, summarize meeting notes, and keep everyone aligned. A strong sense of ownership and the drive to grow and shape the customer success function over time. Benefits 🚀 Benefits: Fully remote work Competitive monthly salary package Equity share and qiibee tokens (QBX), sharing in our success Fast-paced remote startup environment 💫 About us: At qiibee, we're on a mission to turn loyalty currencies into one of the world's largest payment methods. Our points exchange platform lets businesses and loyalty programs issue and redeem loyalty rewards instantly, unlocking real purchasing power and economic freedom for their members. We're an AI-first, international team, building an increasingly agentic company where AI handles the busywork so our people can focus on what matters most: our customers. We're looking for ambitious, high-performing people who are eager for growth, challenges, and continuous learning to help us turn our vision into reality. title: Servicetechniker/in Robotik
description: Du bist Sebotics in deiner Region: Techniker/in und Organisator/in in einem – du installierst, betreust und machst uns lokal bekannt. Das Vertrauen, das der Verkauf am Telefon aufbaut, vertiefst du vor Ort. Deine Kunden liegen nah bei dir – du arbeitest beim Kunden, nicht im Auto. Deine Aufgaben Begehungen: Räume, Wege, WLAN, Türen und Lifte prüfen, Fotos machen, sauber an den Verkauf übergeben. Vorführung und Installation: Roboter vorführen, einrichten, kartieren, in Betrieb nehmen und das Personal schulen. Service und Support: Wartung und Störungen vor Ort; eingehende Supporttickets deiner Region bearbeiten. Bestandskunden: Kunden anrufen, nachfragen und Ausbau erkennen (weitere Roboter, Serviceverträge) – abgestimmt mit dem Verkauf. Technische Beratung im Team: Der Verkauf holt dich in Teams-Gespräche mit Kunden: Du berätst technisch auch remote, nicht nur vor Ort. Sichtbar sein: Projekte in den sozialen Medien zeigen (z. B. LinkedIn) und bei lokalen Events und Vorführungen mithelfen. Lager und Weiterbildung: Regionallager betreuen, dich laufend weiterbilden, im Wiki mitschreiben. Das bringst du mit Technische Ausbildung (z. B. Elektronik, Mechatronik, Automation, Informatik) oder vergleichbare Erfahrung. Leidenschaft für Technik: Du tüftelst gerne und holst das Maximum heraus. Kontaktfreudig und sicher im Auftreten: Du erklärst Technik verständlich und trittst bei Kunden und Partnern sicher auf – auch bei einer kurzen Präsentation vor Publikum. Ehrlichkeit: Du sagst, was Sache ist – auch wenn es nicht läuft. Ohne Ausreden, mit Lösungen. Teamgeist: Du hast Freude an der Arbeit und an den Menschen um dich herum. IT- und PC-fit: Sicher mit Laptop, WLAN, Apps, Ticketsystem und Teams; aktiv in sozialen Medien. Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch, in der Romandie Französisch, im Tessin Italienisch – auch in der Bewerbung; Englisch von Vorteil. Wohnsitz und Arbeitsbewilligung in der Schweiz, in Liechtenstein, in Deutschland oder in Österreich (keine Relocation, keine Visa-Unterstützung). Führerschein Klasse B; ideal mit Garage oder Lagerraum in deiner Region. Passt nicht, wenn du … um Punkt fünf Feierabend machst, egal was beim Kunden läuft, Telefon, Kunden und soziale Medien lieber anderen überlässt, schon alles besser weißt, bevor du unsere Geräte kennst. Das bieten wir Lohn: Brutto pro Jahr bei 100 %, in 13 Monatslöhnen – Schweiz bis CHF 70'000, Deutschland und Österreich EUR 45'000 bis 60'000, je nach Erfahrung und Leistung. Volle Ausrüstung: Werkzeug, Arbeitskleidung, Handy, Laptop, Vorführ- und Testroboter. Geschäftsfahrzeug nach Vereinbarung und Spesen bei auswärtigen Einsätzen. Schulungen bei Sebotics und den Herstellern; Anerkennung wie „Techniker/in des Monats“. Perspektive: Mit guter Leistung wächst du schnell – fachlich und beim Lohn – zur Leitfigur deines Gebiets. title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.</p> <p>Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.</p> <p>You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. title: Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)
description: Warum es diese Stelle gibt Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten. Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut. Was du machst Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert. Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen. Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material. Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme. Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten. Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels. Deine ersten 90 Tage Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live. Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus. Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen. Wen wir suchen Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig. Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text. Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung. Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung. Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei. Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei. Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem. Was wir bieten €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung. Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch. KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze. Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. 30 Tage Urlaub. So bewirbst du dich Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie. Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann: 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst. Eine Probeaufgabe von etwa 4 bis 5 Stunden: Markt anschauen, ein Testpaket entwickeln und ein Creative fertig bauen. 30 Minuten, in denen du uns die Probeaufgabe vorstellst und wir über die Erwartungen beider Seiten sprechen. Angebot, schriftlich. Vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin brauchen wir in der Regel zwei bis drei Wochen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers’ objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap. We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments: Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical Focus - Large companies with established ARR Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers. Location: This role will be based remotely. What your day will look like Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more. Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries. Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives. Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales. Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention. Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests. Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities. What we are looking for in you The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for: Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT. Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software. Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects. A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally. Knowledge of agile methodologies. We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us! Additional skills that you might also bring Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus! What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

title: Manager, Customer Support
description: Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. We're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead a high-performing team of Support Specialists and Support Engineers. This isn't traditional support management—you'll treat support as a product, using data to diagnose friction, design experiments to improve resolution speed and quality, and continuously optimize the system that delivers customer outcomes. You'll be the operational leader for Elation's support experience, owning team performance, development, and the daily execution of SLA commitments. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Operations to translate support insights into product improvements, and build the analytics infrastructure that makes support performance transparent and actionable. If you think like a Product Manager, love operations, and want to build a technically oriented team that drives real impact, this is the role for you. What You'll Do Lead a High-Performing Team Manage approximately 8–10 Support Specialists and Support Engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, development, performance management, and retention Conduct weekly 1:1s focused on skill development, case quality review, and career growth Coach your team to critically evaluate AI-generated recommendations and deliver exceptional customer outcomes—quality over speed Hold your team accountable to SLA commitments, including time-to-resolution, backlog targets, and customer satisfaction scores Own Support Operations & Processes Manage the daily execution of case triage, routing, and escalation workflows to ensure efficient resolution Monitor case queue health in real time and identify bottlenecks or quality issues before they impact customers Design and run experiments to improve case resolution speed, first-contact resolution rates, and customer satisfaction Build and maintain the Support playbook, including documentation, troubleshooting guides, and AI-assisted workflow standards Own the QA process for AI-assisted case resolution; audit quality regularly and coach to gaps Drive Data-Driven Insights Treat metrics as your product: build dashboards, define KPIs, and make support performance visible and actionable Run weekly case reviews with your team to identify patterns, high-volume issue types, and systemic product gaps Translate case data into prioritized feedback for Product and Engineering teams Own monthly reporting on team performance, SLA trends, top case drivers, and escalation patterns Use data to forecast capacity needs, identify skill gaps, and recommend training investments Partner Cross-Functionally Work closely with Engineering Managers to keep support context present in product decisions Collaborate with Customer Operations on service standards and cross-functional initiatives Surface urgent product issues and provide context for prioritization decisions Build feedback loops to ensure case-driving issues get resolved upstream Improve Systems Continuously Proactively identify inefficiencies in support workflows, tooling, or documentation and drive improvements Recommend and implement automation that increases team leverage (e.g., AI response quality, case routing logic, knowledge base search) What Success Looks Like First 90 Days Build trust with your team through 1:1s, understanding strengths and challenges, and establishing clear expectations Master the case data: know the top case drivers, current SLA performance, and team capacity model Establish effective partnerships with Engineering Managers Identify and fix 1–2 quick-win process inefficiencies First Year SLA performance: Your team consistently meets time-to-resolution targets and keeps backlog under control Case quality: AI-assisted case resolution accuracy at 95%+; zero critical escalations due to poor case handling Team development: At least one team member promoted or developing toward the next level; retention at 90%+ Product impact: Your case data analysis drives 3+ roadmap prioritization decisions that reduce case volume Operational leverage: You've built analytics dashboards, improved documentation, and implemented at least one automation that increases team impact by 10%+ What We're Looking For Required Experience 5+ years in technical support, customer success operations, or technical account management, with at least 2 years managing people Proven track record managing to SLAs in a technical support or customer operations environment Experience with technical products (SaaS, B2B software, healthcare tech preferred) where support requires genuine technical troubleshooting, not just scripted responses Data fluency: You've built dashboards, analyzed trends, and used metrics to drive operational improvements—not just reported them Skills & Attributes Systems thinker: You see support as a process to optimize, not just a queue to clear; you've redesigned workflows or implemented tooling that improved efficiency Product management mindset: You understand root cause analysis and think about preventing issues upstream rather than just resolving them faster Technical credibility: You can learn product architecture, understand complex workflows, and coach support engineers on technical cases Coaching-oriented: You develop people through feedback, skill-building, and stretch opportunities—not just task assignment High standards with empathy: You hold your team accountable while supporting their growth Cross-functional collaboration: You've worked effectively with Engineering, Product, or Customer Success teams where success required partnership Comfortable with ambiguity: You're excited to build operations for a new support model without a perfect playbook on day one Nice to Have Experience in healthcare, health tech, or regulated industries Exposure to AI-assisted support workflows or LLM-based tooling Prior experience as a technical support engineer or individual contributor before moving into management Familiarity with Notion, Linear, Salesforce, Intercom, or similar support/case management platforms Salary range: $110,000-140,000 CAD Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. title: Technical Support Specialist - Tier 1 - US Remote
description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! Position Overview When a nurse can't reach the right physician at 2am, or a critical alert isn't routing where it should, our Support Specialists are the ones who fix it. Join PerfectServe's 24/7/365 support team and help keep clinical communication running for the hospitals, physicians, and care teams who depend on it. The Role As a Support Specialist , you'll support and troubleshoot for PerfectServe's end users, physicians, nurses, and system administrators. Day to day, that means user account management, end-user education, on-call schedule management, mobile and web application support, and hands-on troubleshooting. Compensation and Schedule $19/hour to start + shift differential for nights/weekends, plus a comprehensive benefits package effective on day one Most schedules include one weekend day and some holiday coverage We're currently hiring for both day and night shifts Fully remote within the United States Able to start by November 16, 2026 Training New hires onboard and train together on a Monday through Friday, daytime (EST) schedule, with mentorship before moving to your permanent shift. We expect 100% attendance during your first 60 days, this nesting period is what sets you up to succeed once you're on your own. What You’re Bringing A dedicated, distraction-free home workspace with hardwired or verified reliable high-speed internet, this is a remote, mission-critical support role, so a stable setup matters from day one A track record of troubleshooting through complex issues methodically, be ready to walk us through a real example: what broke, how you worked the problem, and how you resolved it Experience supporting customers across multiple channels, phone, chat, and ticketing systems, and comfort managing escalations across all three A pattern of growth in past roles: taking on more responsibility, training others, or earning a promotion, rather than a string of short, similar stints Real interest in what PerfectServe does and why healthcare communication matters to you, we'd rather hear that than "the schedule works for me" Excellent written and verbal communication skills High customer empathy and a genuine drive to help people Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities Willingness to work evenings, overnights, and/or weekends What You’ll Be Doing Field incoming client communications via phone, chat, and our online customer portal Help end-users administer their PerfectServe applications and train them on our phone, mobile, and web tools Troubleshoot message delivery and content issues, from root-cause diagnosis through configuration fixes Build and revise user accounts based on established standards Partner with hospital IT teams to resolve mobile and web connectivity issues Consult on and configure custom application builds to fit end-user workflows Collaborate with customer success, integration, and technical teams on escalated issues Our Team, Our Culture We're a distributed team, and we keep cameras on for internal and external meetings, it's a small thing that keeps us connected and engaged even when we're not in the same room. About PerfectServe PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care. Environment, Physical & Other Requirements This position requires interaction with people and technology while either standing or sitting. In order to best service our customers on the phone, face-to-face, or on the computer, all employees must be able to communicate with or without reasonable accommodation. Depending on the assignment, may require ordinary ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; or the ability to stand, walk and manipulate (lift, carry, move) light to medium weights of 10 - 50 pounds. Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm, hand and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard, operate equipment and read technical information. PerfectServe is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship. This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. PerfectServe, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer -----M/F/D/V. Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a compensation range at $19.00 USD / hour , with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. title: Senior International Sales Recruiter, UK/EMEA
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. "At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you." – Alicia Strait , VP of Talent, TRM Labs As TRM expands across EMEA and other global markets, our ability to hire the right sellers, compliance experts, and go-to-market talent in-region determines how fast our blockchain intelligence reaches the institutions and agencies fighting illicit finance worldwide. As an International Sales Recruiter , you'll own high-priority searches across EMEA and beyond — Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business roles — partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define strategy, map regional markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision. Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of the hires you make across TRM's international business functions. The impact you'll have: Own full-cycle recruiting for international roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions. Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, including advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and close approach. Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets. Develop regional talent maps across priority markets that include high-performing companies, competitive talent, referral networks, and specialized candidate communities. Create an exceptional candidate experience where every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles. Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time. Drive urgency and decision quality through clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions. Continuously improve international recruiting including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution. Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving. What we're looking for: 7+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international sales hiring in high-growth technology companies. Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions. Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt strategy by region, function, and candidate profile. Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing. The ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, and operations. Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality and translate them into action. Exceptional stakeholder management that includes building trust, influencing hiring managers, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor. Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for stakeholders. High ownership, autonomy, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, specialized, business-critical searches. The ability to operate effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment with strong overlap across EMEA and U.S. business hours. About the team: Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates. We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together. We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting. We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration. Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review. Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen. Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled. Our Onboarding Process: Within your first 30 days , you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions. Within your first 60 days , you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds. Within your first 90 days , you’ll have made 2–3 hires . The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role: Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000. Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan. Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. title: Feasibility Manager
location: Hungary,  Poland,  Romania,  Serbia,  Slovakia,  Spain,  UK
description: Due to our continued growth, Precision for Medicine is looking for a Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager to join our European team. This position can be covered fully remotely in UK, Spain, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia. The final title, Senior Feasibility Associate or Feasibility Manager, will be determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and demonstrated level of responsibility. Position Summary: The Feasibility Manager is a member of Precision for Medicine’s expert Feasibility Department and is responsible for delivering evidence-based feasibility assessments across pre-award, post-award, rescue, and stand-alone engagements. The role combines clinical and scientific interpretation with operational intelligence and data analysis to develop country, site, patient-pool, and recruitment recommendations. The Feasibility Manager partners with Business Development, Clinical Operations, Medical, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that recommendations are scientifically credible, operationally realistic, and clearly communicated. The successful candidate will manage assigned feasibility deliverables, present analyses and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients, and contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s feasibility capabilities and competitive position. Key responsibilities Lead or contribute to feasibility assessments for client requests for proposals. Review clinical protocols, study assumptions, client information, and operational plans for United States and global clinical trials. Conduct and synthesise competitive landscape, historical recruitment, standard-of-care, treatment landscape, epidemiology, country, site, and patient-pool analyses. Translate evidence into clear country, site, enrolment, and operational recommendations. Develop logical, transparent rationales for assumptions and identify important data limitations and feasibility risks. Present feasibility methods, findings, recommendations, and supporting rationale to Business Development colleagues, proposal teams, and clients. Collaborate with internal colleagues, external consultants, data partners, investigators, and sites to gather and interpret feasibility information. Plan, coordinate, and analyse targeted site and investigator outreach, as appropriate. Participate in bid-defence meetings and client discussions. Contribute to the continued development of feasibility methods, data sources, tools, templates, and best practices. Share knowledge and support the development of colleagues within the Feasibility team. Work effectively across functions, therapeutic areas, and geographic regions. Contribute to initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s scientifically driven approach and client offering. Required qualifications and experience: Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline. At least two years of relevant experience in clinical trial feasibility, clinical operations, site intelligence, epidemiology, clinical research, or a related area. Experience conducting or contributing to clinical trial feasibility analysis and site or country identification. Ability to interpret clinical, scientific, epidemiological, and operational information and develop clear recommendations. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Equivalent combinations of education, qualifications, and relevant experience may be considered. Preferred qualifications and experience Postgraduate degree in life sciences, public health, epidemiology, data science, or a related discipline. Experience supporting global clinical trials. Experience in oncology, rare disease, or other complex clinical-development programs. Experience presenting analyses and recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders. Familiarity with clinical-trial intelligence, epidemiology, site-performance, or claims and real-world-data platforms. Skills Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple evidence sources. Ability to develop and communicate a clear rationale for feasibility assumptions and recommendations. Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of the overall study strategy. Ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables, stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Confidence working with web-based data, intelligence, and analytics platforms. Strong ownership of deliverable quality, accuracy, and timeliness. Collaborative working style and ability to operate effectively in a matrix environment. Ability to work independently while seeking input and escalation appropriately. Working knowledge of ICH-GCP principles. Precision for Medicine brings together clinical-trial execution, scientific expertise, laboratory capabilities, and advanced data sciences to help life sciences organizations improve the speed, cost, and likelihood of successful clinical development. The organization has a strong focus on oncology and rare diseases and offers the opportunity to contribute to complex programs that seek to bring meaningful therapies to patients. Address and resolve customer inquiries or disputes related to billing, payments, and account discrepancies. Prepare and send collection letters, statements, and other necessary documentation to customers. Ensure compliance with relevant debt collection laws and regulations to avoid legal issues. Generate and analyse reports on the status of outstanding debts, collection efforts, and other relevant metrics. Provide excellent customer service while being firm and persistent in the collection process. Required Qualifications Minimum 2 years’ experience in collections execution Experience utilising collection tools (GetPaid or similar) Clear experience in the fundamentals of a collection process: calls, emails, escalations, dispute management & documentation Preferred Qualifications Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence internal stakeholders to drive results Strong customer relationship skills (internal and external) High energy, positive attitude, and a team-first mentality — someone who thrives in a results-driven, high-performing environment Proven ability to manage a book of business spanning larger accounts down to medium/small size accounts, with strong strategies to secure cash Comfortable with call/contact metrics and financial & operational metrics (Cash, Aged AR, 90+, dispute identification & resolution intervals) #IND2 #LI-KH1 Additional information Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We also offer: 100% remote work Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from A MacBook set up and ready from day one, plus a $500 stipend to design your ideal workspace Central European Time (CET) hours to support a balanced schedule for our Poland-based team Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs About the role As a Software Engineer II, you bring growing technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of features and components across the product. title: Catalog & Content Lead
description: About the job Fresh Prints is about to go through the biggest catalog shift in company history. We've always sold custom apparel to groups - chapters, teams, clubs. That's changing: we're building a catalog where every product and design has its own shoppable page, so anyone can browse and buy directly, the way you'd shop at any other ecommerce store. Over the next year, our catalog will grow roughly 100x, from a few hundred listings to tens of thousands of individual product pages. Someone has to build what makes that catalog possible: the publishing pipeline, the QA process, and a team of three that can run it well without you standing over their shoulder. This isn't a maintenance job. Nobody here has run a catalog at this scale before, so a lot of what you build in the first few months won't have a template to follow — you'd be building the foundation for a 100x scale-up from close to day one, and a year from now, you'll have a genuinely rare story to tell about what you built and when. We're looking for someone who can lead a small team, own a production calendar, and hold a real quality bar under pressure, who also happens to be technical enough to get hands-on with a CMS when something needs fixing. If building the system behind a company's next stage of growth sounds like the kind of problem you want to solve, please apply. You'll own our product catalog, our QA process, and the team of three that grows with it. Build the systems now, and a year from now your team is running most of it without you, while you're already onto the next big problem. What You'll Own Team Leadership & Coaching Manage and mentor a team of three, setting clear expectations for quality, pace, and ownership Delegate real ownership to your team rather than staying the single point of failure for every workflow Know the difference between a capacity problem, a process problem, and a performance problem, and address each the right way Project & Production Management Own the production calendar across launches, campaigns, catalog updates, and ad hoc requests Turn incoming requests into scope, owners, deadlines, and QA checkpoints Forecast your team's capacity, flag conflicts before a deadline is at risk, and negotiate scope when priorities collide instead of letting the team silently absorb an impossible workload Asset & Catalog Quality Own product publishing across every product line, with accurate metadata and imagery before anything goes live Design and scale the QA process that catches errors before they reach the live site as the catalog grows toward tens of thousands of listings Document workflows clearly enough that the team doesn't depend on any one person's memory Cross-Functional Coordination Be the one who keeps product work moving across departments on schedule, with risk flagged early and a clear path forward whenever something's blocked Who You Are You love building systems. You can turn an ad hoc process into something documented and repeatable that the whole team can run. You're scrappy under pressure. You'll sketch out a tracker on the spot or jump into the work yourself rather than let something slip while you wait for the perfect tool. You understand product data at a deep level — comfortable enough inside a CMS to know when a field is derived from somewhere else, and enough of a craft eye to know what's actually wrong with an asset. You can hold five moving projects and competing deadlines in your head at once without one quietly slipping through the cracks. You're direct. When a teammate is falling short, you say so the same day, not weeks later. When you're the one falling behind, you say that too. You're curious about where the catalog is breaking. You'll notice the colorway that's slightly off before a customer ever does. Requirements 3+ years of relevant experience Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills Prior experience leading or co-leading a team, with genuine ownership of people and their output A track record of managing projects against hard deadlines with multiple contributors A track record of building or scaling a QA process for content or product output at high volume Hands-on fluency with a content management system (CMS) or product information management (PIM) platform. You understand the underlying data structure, not just the interface Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop (Illustrator is a plus) Strong differentiator, not required: scripted or automated production workflows in Photoshop, or comfort building lightweight tools using AI, no-code platforms, or basic scripting. Compensation Between $900 - $1,000 (adjusted for experience), with $40 night shift allowance Working Hours: 3 PM - 12 AM Philippine Time. Location: Work from Home/Remote At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees. Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity, actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

title: AI Automation & Ops Lead
description: AI Automation & Operations Lead Company: Nucleus Network Location: Remote Employment type: Full-time Working hours: To be confirmed based on required US time-zone overlap About Nucleus Network Nucleus Network is built around a simple mission: introducing great people to great people. The business operates across three core areas: Nucleus Advisory: A warm-introductions-as-a-service business that has made and tracked more than 10,000 introductions. Nucleus Ventures: A venture capital firm incubated by Nucleus that deployed more than $54 million across 28 companies within 2.5 years. Nucleus Community: An events business that hosted more than 70 experiences over the past year across New York City, Los Angeles, Miami, San Francisco, Las Vegas, Cannes, and other locations. As Nucleus continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help us use AI and automation to operate more intelligently, efficiently, and at scale. About the Role We are looking for a highly resourceful and hands-on AI Automation & Operations Lead to identify, build, and implement AI-powered workflows across Nucleus Network. This is not a traditional machine-learning or AI research role. You will not be expected to build foundational AI models. Instead, you will use existing AI tools, automation platforms, APIs, and lightweight development to solve real operational problems. You will work closely with the Nucleus leadership team to understand how different parts of the business operate, identify repetitive or inefficient processes, and turn those opportunities into reliable systems and automations. A major initial focus will be improving how Nucleus captures, organizes, enriches, and uses relationship data. However, the role will eventually support processes across Nucleus Advisory, Nucleus Ventures, Nucleus Community, and other internal functions. The ideal candidate is curious, technically capable, business-minded, and comfortable taking an ambiguous problem from idea to working solution. What You’ll Do Identify opportunities for AI and automation Learn how different teams and business units at Nucleus currently operate. Map existing workflows and identify repetitive, manual, or inefficient processes. Recommend where AI and automation can create the greatest operational impact. Prioritize projects based on business value, complexity, urgency, and scalability. Help the leadership team distinguish between processes that should be automated and those that still require human judgment. Build AI-powered workflows Design and implement practical AI automations from start to finish. Connect the different platforms used across the organization to create reliable, end-to-end workflows. Use large language models and automation tools to extract, structure, classify, enrich, summarize, and route information. Build lightweight internal tools, interfaces, dashboards, or applications when existing tools are insufficient. Use APIs, webhooks, scripts, and no-code or low-code platforms to connect systems. Evaluate and introduce new AI tools when they offer a clear business benefit. Improve CRM and relationship management Help build or improve Nucleus’s internal CRM and relationship-tracking systems. Make it easier for team members to capture and update contact information. Automate the enrichment and organization of contact and company data. Create systems that identify stale relationships or incomplete records. Develop lead-scoring workflows based on ideal customer profile fit. Build systems that surface relevant relationship insights and recommend high-quality potential introductions. Improve how Nucleus records, tracks, and analyzes introductions across the business. Own implementation and maintenance Translate loosely defined business needs into clear technical solutions. Build prototypes quickly, gather feedback, and improve them through iteration. Test automations carefully before deployment. Monitor existing workflows and troubleshoot errors or performance issues. Maintain and improve systems as tools, processes, and business needs change. Build safeguards and human-review steps where accuracy or business judgment is important. Document systems clearly so that other team members can understand and use them. Drive adoption Explain technical solutions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders. Train team members on new workflows and tools. Gather feedback from users and incorporate it into future improvements. Create simple documentation and operating procedures. Help establish practical standards for the responsible and secure use of AI across the organization. Examples of Projects You May Work On Your projects could include: Creating a frictionless system for adding new contacts to the CRM. Automatically identifying stale contacts and prompting the appropriate team member to follow up. Scoring prospective clients based on their fit with Nucleus’s ideal customer profile. Enriching new contact and company records using available internal and external data. Suggesting relevant introductions between people in the Nucleus network. Converting meeting transcripts, emails, and notes into structured CRM updates. Building workflows that track introductions and their outcomes. Automating follow-ups after meetings, events, and introductions. Creating internal search or knowledge tools that make information easier to find. Automating repetitive operational tasks across Advisory, Ventures, and Community. Building dashboards that help leadership understand activity, relationships, and performance across the business. Tools and Technology Nucleus currently works with tools including: ClickUp Slack Google Workspace DocuSign Superhuman Fathom Wispr Flow Claude You do not need to have experience with every tool in the current stack. However, you should be comfortable learning new platforms quickly and connecting different systems through native integrations, automation platforms, APIs, or lightweight custom development. Experience with tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Retool, Notion, HubSpot, OpenAI, Claude, or similar platforms would be valuable. What We’re Looking For At least three years of relevant experience in automation, AI implementation, operations, product, business systems, software development, or a related field—or a portfolio that demonstrates equivalent practical ability. Experience building working automations that solve real business problems. Strong practical understanding of generative AI and large language models. Experience using AI tools as part of everyday work, not only for experimentation. Ability to connect applications using APIs, webhooks, native integrations, or automation platforms. Comfort using no-code and low-code platforms. Enough technical fluency to use scripting or lightweight development when necessary. Strong process-mapping and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand a business problem before choosing a technical solution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with nontechnical stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, particularly when testing and deploying automated workflows. Ability to manage projects independently and deliver solutions with limited direction. Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where requirements may initially be unclear. Nice to Have Experience building or managing CRM systems. Experience with relationship intelligence, lead enrichment, or recommendation systems. Experience working with venture capital, professional services, events, communities, or relationship-driven businesses. Experience developing internal tools or lightweight web applications. Familiarity with databases, structured data, and data-cleaning workflows. Experience with JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar technologies. Experience managing data privacy, security, access controls, and responsible AI practices. A portfolio, case study, or demonstration of AI-powered workflows you have built. You’ll Be a Great Fit If You Naturally look for ways to make processes simpler and more efficient. Enjoy turning ambiguous ideas into useful, working systems. Are comfortable experimenting, but care about reliability when moving something into production. Can move between strategic thinking and hands-on implementation. Focus on business outcomes rather than using technology for its own sake. Learn new tools quickly and are not attached to one specific platform. Take ownership of projects and follow through without needing constant direction. Ask thoughtful questions before building. Are excited by the opportunity to shape how an organization uses AI from the ground up. What Success Could Look Like During your first few months, you will be expected to: Develop a strong understanding of Nucleus’s business units, systems, and operational processes. Review the existing automation wishlist and recommend priorities. Identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI and automation. Launch initial automations that measurably reduce manual work or improve data quality. Improve the way contacts, relationships, and introductions are captured and tracked. Establish a repeatable process for proposing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining automations. Create a practical roadmap for future AI implementation across Nucleus. Longer term, success means that Nucleus operates with better information, fewer manual processes, stronger internal systems, and a thoughtful AI infrastructure that can scale with the business.

title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
description: About DevRev At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. About the Role: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes. What You'll Do: Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers. Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows. Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow. Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience. Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making. Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback. Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment. Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations. Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements. What You Bring: Experience: 3+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus. Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go) Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions. Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures. Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability). Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures. Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution. title: Clinical Trial Manager

Develop study related clinical documents (e.g. clinical plans, Informed Consent Form templates, study specific forms and manuals, CRF completion guidelines, study trackers, PSV/SIV slides and other Kick-off meetings Generate potential site list from key stakeholders and drive site feasibility process Identify potential risks to the enrollment targets based on feasibility analysis and site’s contracted commitment Develop and finalize the country recruitment/retention strategy Develop timely and effective communication and good working relationships with investigators and study team to ensure effective and timely feasibility, site start up, enrollment, maintenance and close out procedures Lead internal clinical team meetings and sets expectations for clinical team of CRAs and CTAs Address all CRA and site questions and maintains Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) log as appropriate Support in planning and conducting investigator meetings Review and/or approve of IP release packages Oversee, support and track all submissions and approvals to Competent Authorities and IRB/Ethics Committees in conjunction with regulatory departments as applicable Develop clinical
