title: Global Web Growth Project Manager
description: Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es Why join us? Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success. Job Description We’re looking for a growth-oriented Global Web Project Manager (Growth) to help us scale and optimize our B2B web ecosystem. Our setup includes more than 30 websites: One website per market Multiple product-specific websites Multi-language and multi-market coordination This is a high-impact role where web is a core growth channel, directly contributing to marketing database growth and lead generation (MAL and MQL) initiatives across countries. The person in this role will not only manage projects — they will own web performance and be accountable for delivering web targets, especially form submissions and lead generation KPIs. How will you make an impact? Own performance and drive growth through websites Own and deliver web KPIs, especially form submissions (MALs and MQLs). Identify structural and UX opportunities. Plan and execute CRO initiatives. Plan and execute A/B tests. Optimize and create landing pages and conversion funnels. Handle web QAs to ensure high-quality, fast, and bug-free releases. Translate data into action Analyze performance using tools such as GA4 and GSC. Partner with the Web Analyst to turn insights into an optimization roadmap. Transform insights and roadmap initiatives into measurable performance improvements. Lead cross-functional web projects end-to-end Manage website initiatives from ideation and prioritization to launch and post-launch backlog. Create clear project plans, timelines, and stakeholder alignment. Coordinate closely with Marketing, Web Developers, Web Designers, and the Web Analyst. Balance multiple parallel initiatives across markets. Ensure delivery is aligned with business goals, deadlines, and growth targets. What will help you thrive? 3+ years of experience in web management, preferably in a B2B or SaaS environment. Strong understanding of CRO and lead generation. Experience with website analytics tools (GA4, VWO, Hotjar, etc.). Familiarity with CMS platforms, preferably HubSpot. Project management skills with the ability to handle multiple initiatives simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams. Fluent English. What to Expect from Our Hiring Process We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): 1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. 2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Luisa , Global Head of Web Strategy and your potential manager in this role . Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. 3️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with Luisa and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings. 4️⃣ Final Interview – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team. 5️⃣ References & Offer! Why You’ll Love It Here Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. ⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. What We Believe In At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do: Focus on results – we're here to make an impact. Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes. ✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity. Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust. Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job. Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say! _________________________________________________________________________ We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Developer Relations Engineer (London, UK)
description: About Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in London to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you. Why This Role Matters Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers , 1,000+ OSS contributors , and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code. We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected. What You'll Do Make content — Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly Build demos and tutorials — Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix Represent Supabase — Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users You Might Be a Good Fit If You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge You create content that makes people want to open their code editor You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source Requirements This role is based in London to support regular in-person DevRel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the London tech ecosystem. Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.) Experience creating technical content (written or video) Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online) Bonus Points If You Have A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter Prior experience in DevRel or open source Have used (and loved) Supabase What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Product Designer (Full Remote - Italy)

With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Technical & Workflow Fluency Work confidently across modern design, prototyping, and creative tooling Experiment with new workflows that improve speed and output quality Operate comfortably close to engineering constraints and implementation realities Use emerging tools thoughtfully to accelerate exploration and execution Use AI image/video generation tools as part of the design process Cross-Functional Collaboration Communicate design reasoning clearly and confidently Defend ideas thoughtfully Push back when needed Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and Leadership Your Qualifications Hard Skills Strong experience designing high-quality consumer digital products Excellent product thinking and interaction design Strong technical fluency and comfort working with AI tools Strong prototyping skills — able to choose the right approach and fidelity (e.g., design tools vs. code-based prototypes) based on the question being tested Exceptional communication and collaboration skills High design taste and strong visual judgment Confidence operating independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments High ownership and strong decision-making ability Soft Skills Succinct, high-trust communicator — communicates ideas and tradeoffs clearly, quickly, and openly; respects others’ time ⚡ Speed-first operator — keeps momentum high; removes blockers quickly High-agency, product-minded — strong point of view, takes ownership, and drives decisions in ambiguity Collaborative and direct — aligns cross-functionally, pushes back thoughtfully, and keeps teams unblocked AI-obsessed & workflow-innovative — stays at the bleeding edge of AI in design; constantly improves tools, prompts, and processes to increase output quality and velocity Impact-first prioritiser — ruthlessly prioritises high-leverage work and says no to low-impact distractions Comfortable working with NSFW product experiences Bonus Points Experience working on AI-native, conversational, social, or highly interactive products Experience across creative tooling, content workflows, or technical experimentation Experience designing monetisation / subscription products Experience designing for NSFW / adult user experiences Motion, systems, or front-end-adjacent experience We Love Portfolios That Show Strong consumer product case studies Clear evidence of product thinking Technical depth and prototyping capability Original thinking and experimentation High visual craft Real shipped work Clear ownership and measurable impact Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. Why EverAI? Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity ️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale What We Offer ✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description: Role Description As an Infrastructure Engineer, your role will be crucial in shaping and constructing the robust systems that not only support our current flagship products but also lay the groundwork for the next wave of engineering innovations. From optimizing user experiences across various projects to ensuring seamless scalability and data integrity, you'll be at the forefront of shaping the technological backbone of our platform. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll leverage your expertise to tackle audacious challenges and push the boundaries of what's possible. Your contributions will directly impact millions of users, as every line of code you write furthers our mission to revolutionize the way people work and collaborate. Join us in redefining the future, where your passion for building scalable, reliable systems will drive meaningful change on a global scale. Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here . Responsibilities Build infrastructure capable of managing metadata for hundreds of billions of files, handling hundreds of petabytes of user data, and facilitating millions of concurrent connections. Assist in expanding Dropbox 's role as the data-fabric, linking hundreds of millions of applications, devices, and services worldwide, while spearheading efforts to improve interoperability and adaptability across various ecosystems. Measure and optimize Dropbox's analytics platform to maintain its status as one of the most advanced in the industry for extracting meaningful insights from vast data volumes. title: CISO
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Why is this role important for Pennylane? Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company. This step is foundational to delivering a comprehensive financial-services product for our clients, on a model that is robust, scalable, and supervision-ready. From day one, the ACPR will expect PFS to demonstrate clear security governance, effective oversight of critical dependencies, and credible evidence of operational resilience - with a strong security-by-design approach. How will you contribute to the project? You will own PFS’s security governance and overall security and resilience policy, under the direct supervision of the Chief Compliance and Risk Officer. Your contribution is to design a risk and control framework that is proportionate to PFS’s activity and regulatory expectations, and to ensure PFS can evidence "security by design" through auditable, inspection-ready artefacts. In practice, this includes: Policy alignment: ensure consistency between PFS and Pennylane SAS security policies, leveraging the group framework where appropriate while prioritising PFS’s regulatory obligations. Security by design: translate requirements into actionable standards and control expectations, embedded into product and engineering delivery. Operational resilience: shape incident-management and continuity expectations, ensure they are testable, and drive evidence of effective execution. Oversight of key stakeholders: establish effective oversight of Pennylane SAS and key providers, with clear expectations, monitoring and remediation follow-through. This is a role for a technically credible security leader with strategic judgement - with the technical depth to challenge architectures, controls and evidence, and the seniority to own governance and executive reporting. What will your day-to-day responsibilities be? Own PFS Information Security policy: define, maintain and continuously improve PFS security governance, standards and policy set. Manage the PFS risk and control framework: maintain the security risk taxonomy, control objectives, key risks/KRIs, escalation thresholds, and evidence expectations. Embed security-by-design into the Product/Tech development cycle: leverage Pennylane SAS policies and existing ways of working where applicable, ensuring PFS security requirements and regulatory obligations are reflected in the delivery lifecycle, change process and go/no-go decisions, without creating unnecessary process overhead. Ensure operational resilience / continuity / testing: define resilience requirements and ensure end-to-end testing and exercises produce usable evidence and tracked remediation. Manage outsourcing arrangements and audits: oversee security aspects of outsourcing arrangements (intragroup and third parties), ensure auditability and follow through on findings and remediation. Provide executive-level reporting: deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on information-security posture, incidents, resilience testing and remediation to PFS management and the Supervisory Board. KPIs / signals: Policy & standards effectiveness: evidence of adoption (e.g., security requirements consistently reflected in delivery artefacts for material initiatives) and reduction of recurring “same class” issues over time. Core security KRIs (within risk appetite): a small set of measurable KRIs with thresholds and owners (e.g., critical vulnerability exposure, privileged-access exceptions, key third-party risks), tracked and escalated when outside appetite. Resilience testing KPIs: tests/exercises executed vs plan; % of high-severity findings remediated within agreed timelines; retest completion for failed scenarios. Incident classification & remediation tracking: consistent classification, timely escalation, and tracked remediation to closure (including post-incident action closure rate). Audit follow-up tracking: audit findings/actions ageing, % overdue by severity, and executive visibility on the top overdue items. Threat & vulnerability landscape monitoring: regular review of the external threat/vulnerability landscape and its concrete impact on PFS priorities (what changes in controls, monitoring, or roadmap). Ramp-up / expectations during the probation period: Establish the initial PFS security governance baseline (policy set, decision rights, reporting cadence). Propose and align a first set of PFS security KRIs and risk appetite thresholds (with owners and escalation path). Produce a first resilience testing plan (what is tested, frequency, evidence expected) and agree success criteria. Put in place an incident classification approach and a remediation tracking routine that is audit-ready. Profile we are looking for Must-have Fintech and/or Banking experience Strong experience in information security, technology risk, cyber-risk or security assurance, with ownership of complex topics. Proven ability to design and run security governance and a risk/control framework with audit-ready evidence. Experience working with outsourced / third-party / group-shared technology services while retaining accountability. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level reporting. Professional fluency in French and English. Nice to have Operational resilience experience, including DORA-aligned practices (incident management, continuity, testing, third-party oversight). Knowledge of payment and authentication topics (SCA, strong authentication and account recovery patterns). Exposure to PCI DSS scope and payment-card security concepts. Payment fraud and transaction-monitoring familiarity (fraud patterns, controls, investigations, and collaboration with Fraud/AML stakeholders). Recruitment Process 1. title: Financial Services Regulatory Lead H/F
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Why is this role important for Pennylane? Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company. From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk. This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS. How will you contribute to the project? You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology. Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence. In practice, you will: maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations; coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns; establish clear responsibilities, reporting controls and escalation paths across contributing functions; support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one; coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through. You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process. As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements. What will your day-to-day responsibilities be? Maintain the regulatory-obligations inventory: keep a complete and current view of PFS’s recurring and event-driven obligations, with clear owners, deadlines, controls, approval routes and evidence requirements. Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected. Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data. Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements. Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems. Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management. Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence. Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum. Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls. Profile we are looking for Must-have Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory. Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence. Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls. Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably. Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions. Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment. Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders. Professional fluency in French and English. Nice-to-have Experience with ACPR reporting, supervisory interactions or the French regulatory environment. Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm. Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities. Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments. Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions. Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation. Recruitment Process 1. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…) We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. title: Senior Quality Engineer - Tellent Intelligence (AI)
description: Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location. About the Role As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI) , you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers. You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent. Your 12-Month Journey During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing. Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development. After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent. What You'll Be Doing Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves. Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively. Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality. Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain. Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs. Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve. Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers. Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications. What You Bring Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications. AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space. E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright. API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services. Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail. Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus. Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience. Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus. What We Offer Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition. Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team. €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks. 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax. Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year. Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling. €200 home office budget. Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location. About Tellent Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ). With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started. AI in our recruitment process We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy , or chat with us at If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help. title: Fullstack-Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)
description: Wir suchen jemanden, der wirklich mitbaut. Lippe Personal ist seit 2017 auf einen Markt spezialisiert, der gerade unter Druck steht: Arztpraxen, Zahnarztpraxen, Physiotherapeuten und Apotheken in Deutschland finden kaum noch qualifiziertes Personal. Der Fachkräftemangel ist real, die Digitalisierung in diesem Bereich steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen, und die Lösungen, die es heute gibt, sind nicht für die Nutzer gebaut, die sie eigentlich brauchen. Das wollen wir ändern. Wir bauen gerade eine digitale Plattform auf, die den medizinischen Arbeitsmarkt im DACH-Raum neu strukturiert. Datengetrieben, mobil-first, mit einem klaren Fokus auf echten Nutzen fuer Praxen und Bewerber. Das Projekt steckt noch in der Aufbauphase, und genau das ist der Punkt: Du kommst dazu, bevor die grossen Entscheidungen gefallen sind. Was du bei uns machen wirst: Du entwickelst und pflegst eine skalierbare Web-Plattform auf Basis von Next.js und Django. Du baust die Datenbankstruktur in PostgreSQL und Supabase mit auf. Du setzt programmatische SEO-Seiten fuer Tausende Standorte und Fachrichtungen um. Du entwickelst mobile-first Bewerbungs- und Recruiting-Flows, die sich in unter 60 Sekunden abschliessen lassen. Du arbeitest an automatisierten Datenpipelines und der Scraping-Infrastruktur. Du bist direkt im Austausch mit dem Gruender, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. Das ist keine Stelle, bei der du Tickets abarbeitest und auf Reviews wartest. Du bekommst echte Verantwortung, von Anfang an. title: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel + Nuxt/Vue)
description: About ScholarshipOwl ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation. We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered. The Role We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities. You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4 . Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes. Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines. API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers. AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation). Third-Party Integrations *:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions. Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards. Required Qualifications (Must Haves) Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows. Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication). Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS. Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly). API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching. AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation. Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress). DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments. Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives. Good to Have Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience. Certifications *:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering. Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments. Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting. Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery). Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles. Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs). Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Cloud Build). Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor") Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members. Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems. Product-Minded Execution: Strong product ownership mindset—evaluating engineering trade-offs through the lens of user experience, conversion funnel impact, and tangible business value. Why Join ScholarshipOwl? Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers. Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team. High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results. Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time. Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer. Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office. Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery. Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions. Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth. Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world. Ready to lead and build something meaningful? Apply now and help us shape the future of AI-powered education. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Data Science
description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact by developing data scientists, setting clear expectations for them, providing hands-on mentorship, and removing blockers. You will guide and advise multiple data science projects so that they stay on track and have timely delivery with maximum impact. These projects will involve statistical modeling, experiment design, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to validate direction through data, build trust in organizational tactics and strategy by consulting on experiments, and become an expert in our core metrics like searches, installs, and revenue. You'll also drive improvement of the data pipeline. Because of our strong privacy policies, you'll need to think creatively and develop strategies for how we can surface more actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception. As a Director, Data Science, you'll help shape our all-in-one privacy solution and join our mission to show the world that protecting your privacy online can be simple. About You You have 10+ years of experience in data science or ML engineering, with 4+ years leading teams, and a track record of setting multi-team roadmaps and adapting swiftly as priorities shift. You've driven organizational culture toward data-driven decision-making and can translate technical tradeoffs and risks clearly for executives and cross-functional stakeholders. You enjoy coaching experienced data scientists who are already highly skilled. You give direct, actionable feedback and you've built teams where people do the best work of their careers. You can deploy and iterate ML and NLP solutions in production at expert level, with deep knowledge of when to reach for which tools - especially in constrained environments requiring fast responses and strict privacy standards. You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language and stay close to the technical work when it matters most. You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid. You have strong LLM/AI experience including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and AI-assisted development, and can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces using sparse or privacy-constrained data. Preferred: experience at a consumer-facing tech company where data or analytics is core to the product strategy. Compensation This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options: United States : $263,300 USD annually United Kingdom : £183,850 GBP annually Canada : C$346,250 CAD annually Europe/Rest of World : €214,950 EUR annually In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation. Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. Hiring Process Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire . Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to Please note that: You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend. While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week. A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team. By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work. Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process. Key Principles: Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy . We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes. Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors. Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. Product Security Engineering ist von der bestehenden SecOps- bzw. Information-Security-Funktion abgegrenzt. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations. Entwickle und leite eine risikobasierte Product-Security-Roadmap für Commerce Core, Services und weitere Produktbereiche. Sorge für eine ausgewogene Gewichtung von Prävention, Erkennung, Incident-Bereitschaft und Behebung. Verantworte das Modell für Eingang und Triage von Product-Security-Findings aus externen Meldungen, Bug-Bounty-Programmen, Penetrationstests, Dependency-Sicherheitshinweisen, internen Entdeckungen und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Vereinbare Schweregrade und Reaktionsziele mit den Domänenverantwortlichen und InfoSec, leite jeden Vorgang an den zuständigen Code Owner weiter und mache die laufenden Reaktionsfristen sichtbar. Arbeite selbst aktiv mit: Erstelle Threat Models für sicherheitskritische Änderungen , prüfe risikoreiche Designs, untersuche Schwachstellen und implementiere besonders wirksame Sicherheitskontrollen in gemeinsam genutzten Produktkomponenten oder entwickle sie gemeinsam mit anderen. Etabliere wiederholbare Vorgehensweisen für sicheres Design, Sicherheitsreviews, Tests von Missbrauchsszenarien, Dependency- und Code-Scanning, die Offenlegung von Schwachstellen und Incident-Bereitschaft . Koordiniere produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit über eine vereinbarte Dokumentation : GHSA für Angaben zur Offenlegung, ein privates GitHub-Issue oder Epic für Fixes und Backports sowie eine Confluence-Seite zum Sicherheitsvorfall oder Release für Rollen, Entscheidungen, QA-Status und Kommunikationsbereitschaft. Nutze Slack für die operative Abstimmung und verlinke getroffene Entscheidungen zurück in die Dokumentation. Weise gemeinsam mit den Engineering Leads jedem bestätigten Problem eine technisch verantwortliche Person und einen Fälligkeitstermin zu. Eskaliere blockierte Behebungen und verbleibende Risiken über die etablierten Entscheidungswege von Product, InfoSec und der Führungsebene. Verbessere die Sicherheitsabdeckung für unterstützte Versionen und zugehörige Produkte , darunter das Security Plugin, Commercial-Komponenten, Services sowie relevante App- und Extension-Schnittstellen. Leite die technische Aufarbeitung nach Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases. Überführe Ursachen in konkrete Präventionsmaßnahmen mit klarer Verantwortung , Tests, Tools oder Designänderungen und verfolge, ob diese Änderungen Wiederholungen reduzieren. Fördere und entwickle die beiden Engineers weiter , stelle die Abdeckung von Commerce Core und Services sicher und mache die Arbeit des Teams in der Produktplanung sichtbar. Arbeite mit InfoSec, Product Operations, Quality Operations, DevRel, Legal, Customer Support und der Product-Leitung an Entscheidungen zu Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Reaktionen, Releases und Kommunikation. Das bringst du mit: Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Verbesserung der Sicherheit produktiv eingesetzter Produkte. Praktische Kenntnisse in der Anwendungssicherheit, insbesondere zu Authentifizierung, Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, sicheren Integrationen und gängigen Schwachstellenklassen . Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Ausnutzbarkeit, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden, Schweregrad, koordinierter Offenlegung und Incident Response . title: GTM & Growth Engineer
description: Your Mission Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our GTM & Growth Engineer, you build the automation and data behind marketing and growth. You find where work is manual or where data goes unused, build a solution that works in one area, such as paid marketing, lifecycle, sales handovers or content, and then reuse it across the others. You work closely with our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, the Demand Generation Manager and the Marketing Lead, and you ship things with a business outcome attached, not infrastructure for its own sake. You'll be the first engineer in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how our growth stack is built, not just maintain a fixed setup. What you'll do You automate marketing and lifecycle operations: triggers, segments, workflows and personalization in ActiveCampaign and Salesforce, so journeys react to what customers do. You automate paid marketing: audience syncs and suppression from CRM and product data, conversion data fed back to the ad platforms, and campaign feeds and landing pages that adapt to where bids are missing on the Marketplace. Demand Generation owns strategy and budget; you build the machinery. You build the data and signal plumbing: product events, Salesforce, ActiveCampaign, enrichment, transaction history and our BigQuery warehouse, connected, clean and usable. You automate creative production: ad, email and landing-page variants inside our brand templates, with human review before anything goes live. You build once and reuse everywhere: what works in one area becomes a reusable capability for paid, lifecycle, sales and content. You find the manual work and the unused data, such as reporting, list building, call transcripts and enrichment, and replace it with automation and LLM-based tools, including the content engine for SEO and AI search. You give the team fast experimentation: reusable test set-ups, holdouts and measurement, so tests launch in days, not weeks. You launch with care: human checks in every automation, proof against a control or holdout before you scale, and a launch plan with scope, review steps, rollout and rollback. What You Bring You've built marketing or growth automation that runs in production: paid media integrations, CRM and lifecycle workflows, data pipelines, ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business. You're hands-on with APIs, webhooks and automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier or Clay; Python or TypeScript and SQL are a strong plus. You know ad platform and CRM data: audiences, conversion tracking and the limits of attribution. You've shipped LLM-based or agentic automation into a real workflow, not just used AI to write copy faster. You think in outcomes: a working use case in two weeks beats a platform in six months, and you measure what you build. You're careful with what goes live: you check outputs by hand, test against a control before you trust a result, and plan launches step by step with a way back. You work well with marketers and explain trade-offs plainly. Fluent English; German is a plus. Your Benefits Room to shape and grow: The first engineer in Marketing, deciding how our growth stack is built. AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval. Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events. Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Join us – Build the future of construction. Compensation: €70K – €80K • €70K – €80K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: We are hiring on behalf of our client, a fast-growing innovator in the crypto and decentralized finance space who is seeking a Founding Platform Engineer (Staff+ level) to join the team. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.</p> <p>Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.</p> <p>Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.</p></div><p>We’re looking for a collaborative, self-motivated <strong>Senior Software Engineer, Search & AI</strong> to join our growing team.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help build and evolve the customer-facing search experiences that help users discover relevant, high-quality content, along with the backend systems that power them. You’ll work across the stack, with a slight emphasis on frontend development, and collaborate closely with engineers, Product, and Design to deliver intuitive search experiences backed by reliable, scalable search and data systems.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and deliver customer-facing search features and workflows across frontend and backend systems, from technical planning through production</li> <li>Build AI-powered product experiences end to end, from the services behind them to the interfaces that make their output useful and trustworthy</li> <li>Build intuitive, responsive user experiences using Vue while contributing to the Python and Django services that power them</li> <li>Design and improve search, indexing, and retrieval systems that support high-quality content discovery across large volumes of data</li> <li>Build and maintain features and data workflows that leverage technologies such as Elasticsearch, Kafka, Celery, and MySQL</li> <li>Make thoughtful technical decisions and trade-offs that balance customer experience, delivery speed, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and engineering teammates to shape solutions, clarify requirements, and deliver high-quality customer experiences</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive improvements to the performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability of the systems you work on</li> <li>Participate in an on-call and incident response rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues and improve system reliability over time</li> </ul> <h2><strong>To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software</li> <li>Strong experience working across frontend and backend systems and independently delivering features throughout the application stack</li> <li>Proficiency with Python or a similar programming language and experience with Django or a comparable web framework</li> <li>Experience building polished, maintainable user-facing applications with Vue.js or another modern JavaScript framework</li> <li>Experience with Elasticsearch or a comparable search technology, or significant experience working with data-intensive systems</li> <li>Experience making technical trade-offs within complex production systems while balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term quality</li> <li>Experience diagnosing production issues and contributing to the reliability and operational health of the systems you build</li> <li>Experience with TypeScript in a large codebase</li> <li>Experience with design systems or shared component libraries</li> <li>Flexibility to adjust working hours for overlap with teammates in US time zones</li> </ul> <h2><strong>If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Kafka or other streaming or event-driven technologies</li> <li>Experience with MySQL, Postgres, or other relational databases</li> <li>Experience with Celery or other asynchronous task-processing systems</li> <li>Experience building search, discovery, indexing, or information-retrieval features</li> <li>Experience improving frontend architecture, performance, or complex customer-facing workflows</li> <li>Experience working with high-traffic SaaS applications or systems that process large volumes of data</li> <li>Experience building customer-facing features backed by LLMs or other AI models</li> <li>Experience judging whether an AI-backed feature is actually working, through evaluation, testing, or user feedback</li> <li>Interest in journalism, news, media, or social media</li> </ul> <h2><strong>In Addition, We're Always Looking for Candidates Who</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners</li> <li>Take ownership of problems and drive work forward independently while knowing when to involve others</li> <li>Take pride in building readable, testable, maintainable software while making pragmatic technical trade-offs</li> <li>Approach ambiguous or complex problems thoughtfully and use sound judgment to identify effective solutions</li> <li>Contribute to a strong engineering culture through thoughtful code reviews, knowledge sharing, feedback, and continuous improvement</li> <li>Proactively incorporates AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery</li> </ul> <h3>Interview Overview</h3> <p>Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.</p> <ul> <li>30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team</li> <li>A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager</li> <li>Peer interviews with several team members</li> <li>30-minute Bar Raiser</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Travel & Team Engagement Expectations</strong></h3> <p>This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.</p> <h3><strong>Salary</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="0" data-end="108">The anticipated salary range for this role in Ireland is €95,000–€110,000 annually, depending on experience.</li> <li data-start="110" data-end="211">The anticipated salary for this role in Bulgaria is €6,000+ gross per month, depending on experience.</li> </ul> <h6><strong>Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
