GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <h4>This is a shift role. Working 8-hour shifts with 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day.</h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support Engineering at GitLab isn’t just a title - you will be embedded within the Engineering department and will truly operate in an environment where Support and Engineering meet. You’ll interact with customers daily as they encounter the difficult edge cases of running GitLab in complex environments. In the space of a day, you might be doing behind the scenes work of a Linux administrator troubleshooting performance problems by using strace on a particular process, interacting with the Product team to ensure that steps in a bug report are reproducible, or interacting with the Engineering team itself by diving deep into our codebase and putting together a merge request to actually fix a customer issue. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">That’s not all though - you’d equally be invited to contribute to the source code, improve our documentation, and help build out more efficient support processes in our issue tracker. We want to live in a world where everyone can contribute, and as a member of the support team, there are no barriers to using your skills to improve the experience of our users and customers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Some examples of our projects: </span></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li>A<a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos"> solution to capture the state of a customer’s server</a> for easier troubleshooting</li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li>A functionality to<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/"> ChatOps</a> to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">  </span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers and resolve their issues via Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email and video conferencing</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with our </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Product</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Development</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Infrastructure</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Customer Success</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sales</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Teams to build new features and fix bugs, define and shape the product goals, roadmap, priorities, and strategy</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create and update documentation based on customer interactions</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with Support team members (through </span><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Pairing Sessions</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">) and other GitLab team members (for example: as a </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support Stable Counterpart</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Participate in regular rotations for weekday and weekend on-call coverage (daytime only), providing emergency support to our Self-managed and SaaS customers, or working with our SaaS Production team to coordinate incident communications</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Participate in our hiring processes by reviewing applications and assessments, and by participating in interviews.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience in, and passion for managing customer facing cases throughout the entire support lifecycle from initial customer inquiry to triage and reproduction, writing bug reports for hand off to the development team, and case resolution</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Excellent Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent knowledge)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to use scripting languages (preferably Ruby or Bash), and MVC frameworks (preferably Ruby on Rails)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Git and CI/CD</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Expertise in writing support content </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to communicate complex technical topics to customers and coworkers of varying technical skill level</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and technologies like Serverless and Kubernetes</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Understand a range of different GitLab implementations, and how service interruptions impact the customer.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Support team is distributed all over the world across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. Support Engineers work on Support Tickets and helping GitLab’s customers, but they also dig into the code and logs to find out why something is not working as expected. The Collaboration here at GitLab is extraordinary and exciting - Support Engineers </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/workflows/how-to-get-help.html"><span style="font-weight: 400;">solve complex problems together</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and participate in regular pairing sessions and 1:1s, as well as coffee chats and Slack conversations that help them stay connected. Team members are given the ability to structure their shift the way it best suits their private life while maintaining our ability to address customer issues. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thanks to our </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/all-remote/values/#transparency"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Transparency</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> value, you can see what we are working on in our </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support Team</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> page. Additionally, you can see our company </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/direction/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">roadmap</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Gitlab"><span style="font-weight: 400;">listen</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to some of our meetings. </span></p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</span></a></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/all-remote/guide/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">All remote</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/all-remote/asynchronous/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">asynchronous</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> work environment</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/paid-time-off/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible Paid Time Off</span></a></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging."><span style="font-weight: 400

Because our team is fully remote and distributed across the globe, you’ll create intentional, inclusive experiences that work across locations and time zones.</p> <p>You’ll sit within the People Communications and Engagement function and own GitLab’s most visible internal touchpoints, including company-wide assemblies, Company Kick-Off, async-first virtual gatherings, and occasional in-person summits. and inclusive event experiences for a globally distributed workforce across all time zones.</li> <li>Partner with Executive Communications, the Executive Group, senior leaders, People Business Partners, and cross-functional teams to align programming with company priorities and engagement goals.</li> <li>Manage external vendors, production agencies, platform partners, creative projects, and internal event budgets with a focus on quality, cost-effective delivery, and return on investment.</li> <li>Produce high-quality team member stories with agency partners for use in the Loop and internal events.</li> <li>Define and track event success measures, using data and team member feedback to improve future experiences.</li> <li>Explore event technologies and formats, including AI-powered tools, virtual platforms, and hybrid experiences, and use Internal Communications channels to build awareness and extend event storytelling.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience planning and producing large-scale, complex internal events for audiences of more than 500 people, ideally within a distributed or remote-first organization.</li> <li>Experience in corporate events, team member experience, internal communications, or a related function.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-visibility events while maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Clear communication and confidence partnering with and presenting to senior leaders.</li> <li>Experience managing event budgets and working with external production vendors and agencies.</li> <li>Familiarity with virtual and hybrid event platforms, such as Zoom Events, and an interest in using AI tools to improve productivity, ideation, or event personalization.</li> <li>Ability to use GitLab, or willingness to learn and adopt GitLab tools as part of your daily work.</li> <li>A self-directed, proactive approach suited to a high-autonomy, asynchronous environment, along with empathy for remote team member experiences and connection across differences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The People Communications and Engagement function helps GitLab team members stay informed, connected, and aligned in a fully remote, globally distributed company. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As Lead Legal Counsel, Corporate, you'll own securities, public company reporting, and corporate governance work for GitLab, a growing public technology company. You'll join the Legal & Corporate Affairs (LACA) team as a senior individual contributor, reporting to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Compliance.</p> <p>You'll bring a strong securities law foundation and a broad corporate perspective to a small team. Your work will span quarterly reporting and earnings, the annual proxy statement and stockholders meeting, board and committee matters, equity plans, and subsidiary governance. You'll also support mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and other strategic initiatives.</p> <p>You'll work closely with Accounting, Corporate Development, Finance, Investor Relations, People, Product, Stock Administration, Tax, and Treasury. You'll translate complex legal issues into clear recommendations, build trust across functions, and balance legal risk with business objectives. </p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Own securities and public company reporting matters, working with internal stakeholders and external auditors on Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings, quarterly reports, earnings releases, the annual proxy statement, investor presentations, and other public disclosures.</li> <li>Advise on corporate governance, including board and committee processes, the annual stockholders meeting, corporate approvals, equity plan matters, executive compensation, and related compliance requirements.</li> <li>Provide legal guidance on complex entity matters across jurisdictions, including formation, maintenance, reorganizations, intercompany agreements, and wind-downs.</li> <li>Support M&A and other strategic transactions, contributing to diligence, documentation, approvals, signing, closing, and post-closing integration.</li> <li>Engage and manage outside counsel across jurisdictions, coordinating work and ensuring practical, high-quality, and cost-effective advice.</li> <li>Identify legal and business risks, present clear options to senior stakeholders, and monitor legal developments to keep policies, processes, and controls current.</li> <li>Build and improve playbooks, checklists, templates, and workflows for recurring corporate legal work. Train junior legal team members and cross-functional partners to use these resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of demonstrated relevant legal experience, including law firm experience advising US-listed public companies on securities law, corporate governance, and public company reporting. Prior in-house experience is a plus.</li> <li>A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active admission to a US state bar.</li> <li>The ability to independently manage complex legal matters and cross-functional projects, prioritize competing needs, and drive work to completion with limited direction.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical legal issues to non-lawyers and senior leaders and build trusted working relationships.</li> <li>The ability to investigate unfamiliar legal questions, weigh risks against business objectives, and turn recommendations into action.</li> <li>Experience improving legal processes, templates, policies, or other scalable resources.</li> <li>The ability to collaborate in a remote, globally distributed team across time zones and cultures, and willingness to use GitLab in your day-to-day work.</li> <li>Helpful but not required: in-house work at a public software-as-a-service (SaaS), software, or open core company; M&A; cross-border corporate matters; outside counsel management; or legal technology that helps scale legal work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Corporate & Compliance team supports principled corporate governance and GitLab's culture of compliance. We work with leaders and subject matter experts across LACA and the broader company to provide practical, timely legal guidance.</p> <p>LACA is a globally distributed team that supports GitLab's growth through legal expertise, business partnership, and continuous process improvement. and external reporting packages, and lead or contribute to special projects such as process improvements, new disclosure requirements, and merger and acquisition reporting.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What reporting processes, not only executing existing processes.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with the ability to own a calendar, drive accountability across teams, and manage competing deadlines independently.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to research and interpret complex accounting guidance.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders and collaborating with Legal, FP&A, Investor Relations, and business partners.</li> <li>Proficiency with Workiva You stay calm, keep people aligned, and know when to bring in leadership.</li> <li>The ability to turn a complicated or nuanced situation into a clear written story and tie activity to outcomes with numbers.</li> <li>A customer-centric approach balanced with good judgment about what the service, the team, and the company can deliver, and experience working with account teams to bring struggling customers back to health.</li> <li>A record of getting work done across teams through influence and strong working relationships. You'll own execution of pipeline generation programs, including sales plays, PipeGen days, and run the hygiene checkpoints that keep pipeline data trustworthy. You carry programs through to outcomes, not just activity.</li> <li>Experience in a quota-carrying or sales role is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Pipeline Excellence team builds the pipeline engine that turns GitLab's growth targets into predictable, repeatable revenue outcomes. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle.</p> <p>Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.</p> <p>The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.</p> <p>This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.</li> <li>Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.</li> <li>Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. </li> <li>Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.</li> <li>Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product</li> <li>Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.</li> <li>Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.</li> <li>Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:</li> <ul> <li>Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.</li> <li>Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.</li> <li>Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.</li> <li>Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.</li> </ul> <li>Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.</li> <li>Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.</li> <li>Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.</li> <li>A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.</li> <li>Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.</li> <li>Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.</li> <li>Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.</li> <li>Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.</li> <li>Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Orbit connects source code and software development lifecycle data into a structured map of systems, relationships, dependencies, and ownership. You'll help engineers, software leaders, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents understand how teams build software and how changes affect the systems around it.</p> <p>You'll shape Orbit from its underlying graph model and query experiences through customer value, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption. This role combines technical product leadership with building a business around software lifecycle context. You'll balance foundational platform work with near-term customer needs, working directly with technical customers and senior Engineering and Design leaders.</p> <p>You'll join Anand Ahire's product organization and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success, including the teams building GitLab Duo and the broader AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define Orbit's multi-year vision and roadmap across graph models and ontology, ingestion and indexing, query and retrieval, developer and agent interfaces, governance, and enterprise readiness. Build repeatable feedback into roadmap decisions and help customers understand the value of connected graph context over disconnected searches or API calls.</li> <li>Define target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, and the path to product-market fit. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Pricing, and Finance on positioning, packaging, pricing, launch, adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop business cases and track adoption, retention, usage, customer value, and revenue outcomes. Mentor other product managers, share practical frameworks, and represent GitLab's product vision in customer and industry conversations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex technical products or platforms at Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, with a track record of defining vision and roadmaps across multiple teams.</li> <li>Deep technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as developer tools, DevOps, software delivery, data platforms, distributed systems, knowledge graphs, search, APIs, AI infrastructure, or agentic systems.</li> <li>The ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, data models, APIs, scale, reliability, and security.</li> <li>Business judgment and experience in market assessment, product strategy, pricing, packaging, business cases, or commercialization of technical products.</li> <li>Experience taking a product, platform, or category from early concept through launch, customer adoption, and iteration.</li> <li>A customer-first approach and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, engineering leaders, architects, and executives.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, with experience explaining complex ideas, influencing across functions, and resolving competing priorities in ambiguous work.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI tools in product work, including exploring code and data, prototyping workflows, and creating or reviewing merge requests. You take ownership, learn quickly, and move between strategy and implementation detail.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>In GitLab's Analytics organization, we focus on making Orbit's context available through GitLab experiences, developer tools, MCP, APIs, and the command-line interface (CLI).</p> <p>Our challenge is to turn complex, connected data into useful, trustworthy context for engineers and agents. You'll work with engineering and cross-functional partners who value technical rigor, clear product thinking, rapid learning, and direct customer contact. novel vulnerability types with the security community.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices.</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices.</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional presentations.</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies.</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> <li>UK remote based role.</li> <li>Up to 50% travel at times.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</li> <li>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.</li> <li>Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.</li> <li>Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</li> <li>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.</li> Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Professional Services Technical Architect at GitLab, you'll lead the technical direction of customer engagements from early scoping and discovery through delivery. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate</li> <li>Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.</li> <li>Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.</li> <li>Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.</li> <li>Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.</li> <li>Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.</li> <li>Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Prefer location in PST, MST or CST timezone alignment. </strong><strong>Comfortable with up to 30% travel at times.</strong><strong>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</strong><strong>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.</strong><strong>Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</strong><strong>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.</strong><strong>Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</strong><strong>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</strong><strong>Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.</strong><strong>Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</strong><strong>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.</strong><strong>Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience</strong></h4> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.</p> <p>This role models skills and behavior aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. As a Professional Services Technical Architect, you will work more independently than an associate consultant, leveraging deep technical expertise to drive customer outcomes.</p> <h4><br><br><br><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial & Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial & Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.</li> <li value="2">Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial & Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.</li> <li value="3">Support GitLab for Commercial & Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="5">Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.</li> <li value="6">Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.</li> <li value="7">Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.</li> <li value="8">Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.</li> <li value="2">Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.</li> <li value="3">Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.</li> <li value="4">Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.</li> <li value="5">Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.</li> <li value="7">Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.</li> <li value="8">Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Commercial & Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform across their software delivery lifecycle. title: Senior AI Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Senior AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll help build the foundation for GitLab's transformation into an AI-first company. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise AI, you'll be a hands-on technical leader responsible for delivering internal AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>Building fast matters, but it's not enough on its own. This role starts with understanding the real problem: mapping how work moves across teams, tools, and handoffs, identifying the true constraint, and validating whether AI is the right solution before you begin development. From there, you'll take ownership from discovery through deployment, combining strong engineering skills with systems thinking and business understanding.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support, where you will embed AI solutions into key systems and workflows. This role offers the opportunity to shape how GitLab team members work, improve flow across the organization, and help advance our mission in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Diagnose business problems before building solutions. Map workflows, identify constraints, and confirm whether AI is the right intervention. Be prepared to say "this doesn't need AI" when that's the honest answer.</li> <li>Own AI initiatives end-to-end, from stakeholder discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Improve organizational flow by building solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Measure success using flow metrics alongside adoption and ROI.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: leverage and showcase GitLab's AI offerings wherever possible, feeding real-world usage insights back to R&D.</li> <li>Partner closely with stakeholders across functions to understand the real constraints. Ask the right questions, bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, and align on outcomes before jumping to solutions.</li> <li>Define and track success through business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to technical direction by evaluating tools, documenting patterns, and creating reusable foundations that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart - </strong>Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energised by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> <li><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - </strong>You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.</li> <li><strong>AI</strong><strong> & LLM </strong><strong>Technical Depth - </strong>Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Deep, practical experience with modern AI technologies, specifically: Prompt engineering as a core discipline: designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.</li> <li><strong>Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs: </strong>understanding when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to make principled decisions about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns: </strong>tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem: hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and the judgment to know which to reach for and when.</li> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness - </strong>You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defences, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Systems Thinking & Diagnostic Rigour - </strong>The ability to look at a complex process and see the constraint. Comfortable mapping how work flows end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks, and tracing problems to root causes before proposing solutions. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?"</li> <li><strong>Business System Expertise - </strong>Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but to understand what they do, how they fit together, and be willing to build with and across them. A strong understanding of enterprise data models and workflows is essential.</li> <li><strong>Broad Functional Understanding - </strong>Ability to have meaningful conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains and quickly understand their unique needs.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Ownership - </strong>Track record of owning complex initiatives from discovery through delivery. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving to measurable outcomes independently.</li> <li><strong>Product Mindset - </strong>Ability to scope MVPs, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows</li> <li>Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical roles</li> <li>Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking</li> <li>Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development</li> <li>Previous startup or high-growth company experience</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading technical projects with junior engineers</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You will join the Enterprise Technology & AI team. We're the backbone of the organisation, driving transformation in how GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and deliver results for our customers.</p> <p>We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.</li> <li value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="3">Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.</li> <li value="4">Collaborate with <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/">Development</a>, <a Success</a>, and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/">Sales</a> teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.</li> value="8">Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.</li> <li value="2">Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.</li> <li value="4">Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.</li> <li value="5">Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="7">Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.</li> <li value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="3">Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.</li> <li value="4">Collaborate with <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/">Development</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/">Infrastructure</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/">Customer Success</a>, and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/">Sales</a> teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.</li> <li value="5">Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.</li> <li value="6">Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.</li> <li value="7">Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through <a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w">pairing sessions</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart">stable counterpart</a> relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.</li> <li value="2">Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.</li> <li value="4">Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.</li> <li value="5">Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="7">Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Duo Chat team, focused on Chat Engine, you'll build the core AI capabilities behind GitLab Duo Chat, the natural-language and agentic interface to the GitLab DevSecOps platform. Much of your work will involve building flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry, the Python framework built on LangGraph within our Duo Workflow Service that powers agentic chat, and integrating them with the GitLab Rails monolith.</p> <p>You'll own complex backend features from start to finish across both services. You'll integrate large language models and orchestrate multi-agent flows so customers can work faster and more securely across the software development lifecycle. This work sits where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy, and reliability, performance, and answer quality directly shape the customer experience.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design and build flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry using Python and LangGraph within the Duo Workflow Service. These reusable building blocks power agentic Duo Chat and, increasingly, other AI features across GitLab.</li> <li>Develop, ship, and maintain backend features for GitLab Duo Chat across the Python Duo Workflow Service and the GitLab Rails monolith in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.</li> <li>Integrate new generative AI models, providers, tools, and multi-agent orchestration patterns into Duo Chat to expand its capabilities and improve answer quality.</li> <li>Design, implement, and review GraphQL and Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs) and related monolith logic, including chat entry points, permissions, and foundational-flow registration. Keep contracts with frontend clients and host systems reliable and clear.</li> <li>Improve debugging, observability, and test coverage using pytest, RSpec, and related frameworks; track and improve latency, error rates, and test coverage so AI-powered chat workflows stay reliable at scale.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, User Experience (UX), frontend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality improvements through iteration.</li> <li>Document standards, patterns, and learnings with other engineers, raising the bar for safe AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.</li> <li>Participate in Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and strengthen resiliency.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Significant experience building and maintaining production Python backends, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workloads.</li> <li>Practical experience designing and shipping AI-powered, agentic backend features, including large language model integration, tool or function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. You use sound judgment about large language model limitations and safe use in production.</li> <li>Working proficiency in Ruby on Rails, or a strong willingness to learn it. Duo Chat integrates deeply with the GitLab monolith for chat entry points, GraphQL, permissions, and flow registration, and most of GitLab's codebase is written in Ruby.</li> <li>Proficiency designing or extending REST or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability, and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Strong Structured Query Language (SQL) skills and familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including efficient queries and data modeling.</li> <li>Ability to find, diagnose, and prevent performance and reliability problems at scale.</li> <li>Experience solving technical problems of high scope and complexity and advocating for quality, security, and performance improvements across your team.</li> <li>Openness to learning and collaborating in an async-first, distributed team, applying transferable skills from related technologies or domains. Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're part of GitLab's AI Engineering organization and own the AI-powered chat experience embedded across the GitLab platform. Chat Engine is the backend-focused team within the Duo Chat group.</p> <p>We're backend, frontend, and AI specialists working asynchronously across time zones, using issues, merge requests, and documentation as our main collaboration tools. Our focus is to expand generative and agentic AI capabilities, improve the performance and reliability of chat workflows, and strengthen the debugging and testing foundations that let us run AI features safely at scale.</p> <p>For more on how we work, see the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/duo-chat/">team handbook</a> page.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Architecture Engineering: Nonlinear Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Nonlinear Productivity team, you'll find and remove friction across the software development lifecycle using reliable AI-powered automation — diagnosing problems like long review cycles, manual release steps, and brittle automation, then building the automation and process changes that resolve them for good.</p> <p>Some examples of the problems this team takes on:</p> <ul> <li>Cutting the time it takes to complete a good code review — one that still keeps a human in the loop — by half, using agentic solutions.</li> <li>Turning a manual, error-prone release step into an agentic workflow that catches its own mistakes before a human ever has to.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Identify sources of friction across GitLab's software development lifecycle and scope agentic solutions to address them, turning vague pain points into concrete, buildable proposals.</li> <li>Design and build reliable AI-powered systems that follow step-by-step workflows, use tools and safety checks, and correct errors before taking engineering action — the kind of output you can actually trust with real engineering decisions.</li> <li>Build and maintain evaluation tools that judge agent output on correctness, constraint compliance, and cost, not on whether it merely "seems to work."</li> <li>Work across GitLab's codebase as each problem requires, going wherever the friction actually is rather than staying inside one service or product area.</li> <li>Apply distributed systems judgment to identify generated code that may fail under concurrency, at scale, or across self-managed, dedicated, and multi-tenant deployments, catching failures before they reach customers.</li> <li>Collaborate with the India-based group, sharing roadmaps, findings, and reusable agent tooling</li> <li>Take ownership of a greenfield problem space from day one, helping shape a proven internal fix into a capability GitLab could offer customers externally, with your scope and impact free to grow as the team scales.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience building agentic or large language model-based systems — multi-step orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and recovery patterns — and making them reliable in production, not treated as one-off prompts or demonstrations.</li> <li>A track record of working autonomously in unfamiliar codebases, getting oriented quickly, and driving solutions through completion.</li> <li>Strong distributed systems knowledge, including coordination, consistency, idempotency, rate limiting, failure modes, and degradation under load.</li> <li>Proficiency in Go, Rust, or Python, in that order of team priority, and the ability to read and modify code in the other languages.</li> <li>Helpful experience includes shipping autonomous agents that complete real tasks from start to finish; improving build systems, release processes, review workflows, or other parts of the software development lifecycle; and working with globally distributed teams, large language model workload costs, or production constraints across on-premises, air-gapped, single-tenant, and software-as-a-service deployments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Nonlinear Productivity — shortened internally to "NLP," with no relation to natural language processing — is one of GitLab's newest teams: a strategic incubation group that reports into AI Platform leadership under the direct sponsorship of the CTO. It's split into a US group (this role) and an India-based group working the same charter; the two sync on roadmap and tooling a few times a week but otherwise run day to day on their own. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Database Excellence (Ruby)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation.
